Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with signs or symptoms or risk of cardiovascular disease may participate in this training protocol
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has advanced coronary artery disease, ischemic cardiomyopathy, and a history of myocardial infarctions, bypass surgery, and elevated LDL cholesterol, all indicating cardiovascular disease risk.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Coronary artery disease with effort or rest angina or inducible myocardial ischemia as determined by noninvasive testing
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has advanced coronary artery disease with impaired left ventricular function and ischemic cardiomyopathy, consistent with inducible ischemia.
No mention of valvular heart disease in patient history or findings.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Cardiomyopathies, including restrictive, congestive, and hypertrophic phenotypes
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has ischemic cardiomyopathy confirmed by tissue biopsy.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Peripheral-artery disease of upper or lower extremities, with intermittent pain with activity (e.g. claudication) or limb-threatening ischemia
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of peripheral-artery disease in patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Renovascular disease with uncontrolled hypertension, intermittent pulmonary edema, or evidence of ischemic nephropathy
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of renovascular disease, hypertension, pulmonary edema, or ischemic nephropathy.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Congenital heart disease, with communications between chambers or major vessels
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No congenital heart disease or structural abnormalities noted.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Heart surgery patients treated at the Clinical Center prior to closure of the Heart Surgery Branch in 1990
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient underwent bypass surgery, but no information is provided about the surgery date or Clinical Center treatment timeline.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Pregnancy, for those patients who require testing or treatment requiring dobutamine, gadolinium or contrast media or radiation exposure
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of pregnancy or requirement for dobutamine, gadolinium, contrast media, or radiation exposure in patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Inability of patient, parent or legal guardian to provide informed consent
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or legal representative.

Recap: Patient meets multiple inclusion criteria for cardiovascular disease and cardiomyopathy but lacks information on heart surgery timing and peripheral-artery disease. No exclusion criteria are violated.
